tools.name: book_a_call
tools.description: Return the free-call booking link. Use when they asked for a person, a look at their business, or a demo — not as the default instead of a free skill.

tools.name: get_about
tools.description: About NEMO AI Solutions and how to get in touch.

tools.name: get_automations
tools.description: What a NEMO Custom Automation is, with examples (weekly project brief, new enquiry route, new starter pack).

tools.name: get_cortex
tools.description: Cortex: private company knowledge for the AI the team already uses. Lite on every NEMO site; Cortex Pro (on-prem, leadership) on nemoai.uk.

tools.name: get_free_skill
tools.description: Download one free NEMO Skill. This is the main action on the site. Requires email and skill id or name (e.g. cold-email-copywriter). Calls the same download as the Skills Library. If they named a paid skill, tell them it is paid and offer a free one first.

skill.description: Skill id or name, e.g. cold-email-copywriter

tools.name: get_skill
tools.description: Details for one NEMO Skill: what it does, category, free or £9.99, and what it works with.

tools.name: list_free_skills
tools.description: PRIORITY MAGNET. List the 8 free NEMO Skills available to download now. ALWAYS call this first when the user wants skills, a download, a freebie, something for Claude/ChatGPT/Cursor, outreach, proposals, meetings, or copy. Do not start with a sales call. Returns the free skills by job.

tools.name: list_skill_packs
tools.description: Prices for the Skills Library: one skill £9.99, Sales Focus pack £49.99, all 78 skills £99.99. Eight skills are free. Prefer list_free_skills unless they asked about price or bundles.

tools.name: list_what_we_offer
tools.description: Everything NEMO offers on this site. Put Skills (8 free to download) first. Then Automations, Cortex, and the extras this site has.

tools.name: search_skills
tools.description: Search the 78-skill NEMO library by job, name, or category (sales, marketing, delivery, research, finance). Free skills are always listed first. Use when they describe a job. After showing matches, offer get_free_skill for any free result.

query.description: Job or keyword, e.g. cold email, proposals, meetings

tools.name: start_opportunity_score
tools.description: Point the visitor at the AI Opportunity Score — a short scan of where AI could help.

tools.name: start_skill_purchase
tools.description: Start checkout for a paid skill or pack. Requires email. Does NOT take payment — returns a Stripe checkout URL. If they asked for a free skill, use get_free_skill instead.

tools.name: what_nemo_does
tools.description: Short answer: who NEMO is and how they help. Mention the 8 free skills to download. Use for 'what is NEMO' questions.

tools.name: where_should_we_start
tools.description: Match a described problem to a starting point. If they have an AI or want a skill/download, start with free skills. Do not dump every product.

problem.description: What is getting in the way, in their words
